title: The Calibrated Gauge
summary: Round two's four-numbers plate is back as you liked it. The square of dots in the centre is now a precision gauge: a painted bar on a 100-mark scale that measures whichever number you pick, with the share in red, a needle that reads the value and the unit spelled out in words.
story: After the reframe says most teams are fixing the wrong layer, this section lets the market's own published research make the case: four readings, measured one at a time. Its lede ends 'Not one of them moves with more activity', which the founder's letter picks up straight after ('a quarter of activity').
motion: Standalone mockup: the head plays as before (label, the two statement lines rising, the red rule, the lede). The plate draws its top rule, cross and the four readings as in round two.

From 0.7s the gauge draws itself: the baseline, the end caps, the painted track, then the 100 marks rising from 0 to 100. At about 1.35s the red share extends to 17, the needle riding its edge; the unit words fade in as it travels, and at about 2s the black flag latches on '17 / 100'.

It then demos the control once: 95:5 at 2.25s, 77 at 3.05s, 53 at 4.1s, and back to 17 at 5.15s. Each change re-measures like an instrument: the flag lifts, the share retracts to zero, a calibration pulse runs through the marks from 0 to 100, and the share refills to the new value, faster for 5 and slower for 77. Everything has settled by about 6s, on 17. The demo runs these changes a little quicker than a real press.
On 95:5 the red is only the 5 (the flag reads '5 buying now'), and the empty run is measured inside the bar as '95 not buying'.

Interaction: the 17% · 95:5 · 77% · 53% control, a click on any big number, or resting the pointer on one for a moment all re-measure the gauge (about one second). The active number takes a thin ink rule along its top edge; hovering another previews it in grey. The first interaction stops the demo for good.
On the live homepage the head plays as the section arrives. The gauge waits until it is well on screen, then draws itself and measures 17 once. It never steps on its own, and nothing loops.
Reduced motion: 17 is shown measured from the start, any choice lands instantly, and there are no timers.
addressed: 'Round two's design direction was good… more proprietary and more different than usual agency websites': round two's layout is back in full: the head, the four big numbers in a 2×2 with their sources, the hairline cross, the corner registration marks and the caption band with the 17% · 95:5 · 77% · 53% control.
'Change the kind of artifact… inside the center, which was a square with dots': the dots are gone. The centre now holds a single measuring gauge that shows one reading at a time.

'An information block or something painted in colors, or a progress bar thing': the gauge is a painted 0–100 block with the share in red and the rest in stone, split into ten equal sections so the share can be counted at a glance. Below it runs a 100-mark scale, and a needle in a sliding cursor carries a black flag with the reading.

'Equally proprietary, rather than just slapped in': the gauge is drawn into the plate itself. The cross's horizontal line becomes its baseline and turns dark between 0 and 100, the vertical line lands on the 50 mark, and the four corner marks sit over the 0 and 100 end caps. Between readings it re-measures like a lab instrument: it drops to zero, calibrates and fills.

Clear at first glance: each reading names its unit in plain words under the bar (e.g. 'Share of buyers who found the purchase hard'), and 95:5 shows '5 buying now' with the empty run marked '95 not buying'. Because only one reading is on the scale at a time, two different units never share it.

Round three's fixes are kept: the lede 'Every one gets blamed on the pipeline. Not one of them moves with more activity.', the sources as on the current site, and a quiet link to the field note, 'The 17% window · 5 min', in the caption band.
notes: Stage 1393px at 1440 (round 2 X was 1393px; same rhythm: 128px padding, kit head, plate 64px below, two reading rows, 72px band). Head: .ac-head, statement cols 1–8, round-3 lede; the label-row meta 'Fig. 03' is dropped per STORY §9 rule 3 (the band still carries 'Fig. 03 · Four readings, one structure'). Cells: round-2 X layout and type (176px .8 line box), copy restored to the live StructuralEvidence verbatim (claim + so, em dashes, 'brand, product, and price'), 'Ehrenberg-Bass' with a plain hyphen so the brand font renders it. No count-ups (STORY motion budget). GAUGE: a 400×352 registration frame centred on the crossing; the paper knock-out hides the cross inside it. Scale = full frame width, 1 mark = 4px (101 SVG rects at 3/6/9/14px, whole pixels so they render crisp); values 0 · 50 · 100 in 11px mono. Datum = the plate's mid hairline y, redrawn in ink 0→100. A 1px 'plumb' continues the vertical hairline from the frame top to the track top at 50. Track: 52px, filled with --line, so it holds in both skins (--panel-2 vanished on the Kelwin bone). Share: --accent, scaleX(--f). Decades: 9 paper knock-outs every 10 marks over track and share. Needle: 1px ink on the share's edge inside a 23px open cursor window (slide-rule cursor), up to an ink flag (12px mono, paper text) that fits only the active value. 95:5: flag '5 buying now', plus a dimension (end ticks, two leaders, '95 not buying') inside the empty run, shown once the fill settles. Words: 17px Mona, the four stacked in one grid cell (fixed height, nothing reflows), aria-live, each prefixed by screen-reader-only 'n of 100.'. Red: the label square, the rule, and the share (now red on every reading, per the round-4 brief; round 2 kept red for 17 only). JS: --f tweened by rAF (in-out cubic). Re-measure = retract (120 + 260·f ms) → calibration pulse (class restart; 2.6ms per mark, 220ms pulse) → fill (320 + 640·v ms) at near-even speed; every duration × 0.6 in the standalone demo. Hover intent 140ms. Cells are pointer targets; keyboard users use the segmented control (native buttons, aria-pressed). Live (html.km-home): .is-wait hides the gauge until IntersectionObserver sees the frame at 60%, then .is-go plays it once with --g0 120ms; no auto-step; an interaction before then starts it at once. Reduced motion: final markup, instant switches, transitions off. Page context (reframe · evidence · letter): plays on sight, no console errors. ≤760px: statement and lede span 12 columns at 9.4vw, 2×2 numerals at 15vw (support line hidden), gauge full width below the cells (scale and decades scale with --gw), band stacked; verified at 390px with no horizontal scroll. C quotas: one drawing, one title line (the band caption), four registration marks, one dimension (95:5 only), mono lines ≤ 40 characters, none a sentence.
